proves.claim: shardedProofCheck sends the merged checkout's declared timing proof files as plan.timing.

landing.shard-proof.timing-files-in-plan.why: Without it the board cannot give a timing-declared file an exclusive runner.

proves.claim: with a declared timing file shards are offered even when the files fit the runner's cores, and a sharded: false answer runs the proof on this runner.

landing.shard-proof.timing-shards-within.why: Without it a small proof with a timing file runs loaded instead of alone.

proves.claim: with no declared timing file the plan stays { runner, files, cores } and a proof within the cores runs here without an offer.

landing.shard-proof.no-timing-plan-uncha.why: Turning the timing plan on must not change a proof that declares none.
